cards.body:
## Summary
Move the decision 'which sim event plays which cue, where, how loud' out of a hand-written branch chain in arena-entry.ts into a declared `routes` table in data/audio.json, interpreted by a pure `audio-routing.ts` that arena-entry calls and the tests read.

## Description
Today the cue map lives in two places that can drift: the if/else chain at arena-entry.ts:1106-1139 and the test's hand-copied `cued` table (audio-events.test.ts:17). The test's only link to real code is a literal-string regex, so the combat routes built from template strings and ternaries are invisible to it. D2 4.5 is the next audio milestone and adds a dozen or more event-driven cues (death on `down`, interrupt, phase, cast-start, hit variants by family/guarded, per-spell releases via spellId). Each one today means another branch in a 1,210-line combat entry plus a matching manual edit to the test. With routes as data (kind -> {who: player|enemy|any|self-target, cue or cue template like `cast.{school}` / `hit.{family}`, spatial: true, gainFromDamage}), filling a 4.5 cue becomes a JSON edit that the validator and the derived event test check together. The router is pure (event + listener view -> CueRequest[]), so routes are unit-tested without WebAudio.

## Flow
- Add `routes` to audio.json reproducing today's six kinds exactly.
- audio-routing.ts: `spatialMix(dx, dy)` and `routeEvent(event, view)`; template expansion for `{school}`.
- audioDataProblems: every route's expanded cue names exist (`routes:<kind>`).
- arena-entry consumeEvents: keep HUD/impact work, replace the play calls with `for (const r of routeEvent(e, view)) gameAudio.play(r.cue, r)`.
- audio-events.test: derive cued/uncued from routes; drop the hand table.

## Expected impact
D2 4.5 cue work becomes data edits validated in one place; the cue map can no longer drift from its test; arena-entry loses its audio branch logic. No core change: simulation outcomes, replay goldens and VR vectors stay untouched.

## Evaluation
Claim: the router reproduces today's routing exactly and makes route validity checkable.
Before: 0 of 8 acceptance cases pass (no routeEvent, no routes table, uncued is a hand list)
After: 8 of 8
Method: gate - vitest audio-routing.test.ts + audio-events.test.ts + audio.test.ts, then npm run gate and npm run build:game
Result: better
Gate: architecture

cards.title: Cue sheet for the owner listening pass: a scripted bout's audio, drops explained
shared_surfaces: consumes slot A's routeEvent (packages/game/src/audio-routing.ts); if A is not built, the sheet takes cue requests from an injected router and the CLI ships a copy of today's six routes
acceptance: case 1: cueSheet([{t:0, cue:'hit'}, {t:0.05, cue:'hit'}]) -> rows [play, dropped:cooldown] (hit cooldownMs 120)
case 2: three cast.fire requests at t=0 and a fourth at t=0.2 while the first three still sound (fire-a duration from the manifest) -> fourth row dropped:concurrency
case 3: 8 impact (priority 2) sounding, then 'perfect' (priority 0) -> perfect plays and the oldest impact row is marked stolen-by:perfect (same result as admit() at audio-policy.ts:112)
case 4: a sound ends at started + assetDuration / pitch, so a request after that frees its concurrency slot -> play
case 5: summary for a run with sim events of kinds down x2 and interrupt x3 and no routes for them -> silentKinds {down:2, interrupt:3}
case 6: summary.peakBus.effects equals the maximum simultaneous effects rows and never exceeds limits.buses.effects (8)
case 7: CLI on the same seed twice -> byte-identical sheet (deterministic: fixed variation random, seeded bout)
premise: docs/concepts/D2-combat-visuals-art-animation-sound.md:116 - 4.5 calls for 'An owner listening pass with a scripted bout as the fixed test'; nothing produces that script
packages/game/data/audio.json:2 - label 'authored AU4 mix; owner listening pending'
packages/game/src/audio-policy.ts:112-144 - admit() already decides cooldown / concurrency / priority / steal as a pure function, but only live in GameAudio.play (audio.ts:393-403)
packages/game/src/audio.ts:399-401 - drops are written to a 512-entry ring log (audio.json:12) that only the harness snapshot exposes (audio.ts:657-691); the owner never sees why a cue went silent
packages/game/src/screens/pause.ts:222-236 - the only audition surface is 'Test effects', cycling a hard-coded 8-cue list one click at a time, out of combat context
packages/game/src/audio-events.test.ts:30 - four sim event kinds are silent; no report counts how often they fire in a bout
packages/core/src/arena/mage-ai.ts:24,79 and packages/core/src/arena/lab.ts:187,278 - attachMageAI/mageInput and createLab/stepLab can drive a seeded bout headlessly (read-only use)
cards.rollback: Additive: new module, test and script plus one npm script line each in packages/game/package.json and root package.json; revert the commit to remove.
cards.runner_up: Pause audio settings 'Audition' panel listing every cue from audio.json with its bus, priority and last admission result, replacing the hard-coded 8-cue cycle at pause.ts:223.
cards.body:
## Summary
`npm run audio:cuesheet -- --seed 7` replays a seeded Lab duel (reference mage AI both sides, competence from data/forecast.json) through the cue router and the real admit() policy on a simulated clock, and prints a cue sheet: every cue request with time, source event, pan/gain, and outcome (play, cooldown, concurrency, priority, stolen-by), plus a summary per cue and per bus and the count of silent event kinds.

## Description
The owner's listening pass is the open gate for the AU4 mix, and D2 4.5 names a scripted bout as its fixed test. Today the owner can only click 'Test effects' in pause for isolated samples, and when a cue goes missing in combat the reason sits in a harness-only ring log. The data to explain the mix already exists as pure functions: admit() for admission, variation() for pitch/gain, manifest durations for when voices free up. The sheet turns that into one deterministic artifact the owner reads beside the bout (same seed = same sheet), so 'I never hear the stagger' becomes 'stagger dropped 9 of 14 by concurrency at 2 hits', and each 4.5 cue added shows up as fewer silent kinds. The pure core is cueSheet(requests, manifest, random) -> {rows, summary}; the CLI only steps core and prints.

## Flow
- audio-cuesheet.ts: simulated voice pool keyed by bus, end = start + duration/pitch, admit() per request, steal bookkeeping.
- CLI: createLab(seed) + mageInput per tick to the duel cap, route each new event, write text table + JSON to stdout or --out.
- npm script audio:cuesheet; no network, no paid calls.

## Expected impact
The listening pass gets a fixed script and a written explanation of every drop; mix changes (cooldowns, concurrency, bus limits) can be compared before/after on the same seed.

## Evaluation
Claim: the sheet reproduces live admission decisions offline and deterministically.
Before: 0 of 7 acceptance cases pass (no cueSheet module, no CLI)
After: 7 of 7
Method: gate - vitest audio-cuesheet.test.ts; CLI run twice on one seed and diffed; npm run gate
Result: better
Gate: direction
